mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP above its 6-month moving average signals an expansion in economic demand, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of GDP growth above its 6-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 4% triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5% signals a slowdown in labor market growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the unemployment rate is above 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production above its 3-month moving average signals an expansion in economic supply, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of industrial production growth above its 3-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a rise in GDP and a decline in the federal funds rate signals a coordinated monetary and fiscal stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of coordinated monetary and fiscal stimulus (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 3% and a rise in the consumer price index above 2% signal a shift towards inflationary monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 3% and the consumer price index is above 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in payroll employment above its 6-month moving average and a decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signal a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts above its 3-month moving average and a decline in the federal funds rate below 4% signal a coordinated stimulus to the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of coordinated stimulus to the housing market (t-test p > 0.05).
